tex_content.html: \begin{equation} \sup _{x\in X}\left(|g-g_0|_{g_0}^2 +\sum _{\ell =1}^k|\nabla _{g_0}^\ell g|_{g_0}^2\right)<\epsilon ^2. \end{equation} For families $g(t),g_0(t)$ on an interval $I$, the corresponding condition is the same supremum over $(x,t)\in X\times I$, with the metric, covariant derivatives, and norms at time $t$.
